## Epic Vision & Objectives
Master and implement cutting-edge, real-world AI platforms transforming modern DevOps, DevSecOps, and Site Reliability Engineering. Becoming a top 1% DevOps engineer requires orchestrating agentic workflows across every lifecycle phase: from automated internal developer portals and AI-driven SDLC to cluster auto-instrumentation, pre-CI code security governance, and autonomous multi-agent incident RCA.

## Strategic Pillars & Scope
1. **Agentic SDLC & Developer Portals:** Autonomous software factory, developer self-service, and lifecycle automation with **Port (port.io)**.
2. **AI Cluster Observability & Auto-Instrumentation:** Zero-touch cluster-level OpenTelemetry instrumentation and AI trace/metric synthesis with **Dash0 (dash0.com)**.
3. **Pre-CI Shift-Left AI Code Review:** Context-aware security, compliance, and quality auditing with 1-click fixes before CI pipelines trigger using **CodeRabbit (coderabbit.ai)**.
4. **Multi-Agent AI SRE & Automated RCA:** Autonomous agents correlating telemetry, logs, and code for up to 95% root cause accuracy using **incident.io** and **ResolveAI (resolve.ai)**.

## Target Outcomes & Architecture
- End-to-end evaluation architectures and proof-of-concept manifests for each platform.
- Production integration runbooks connecting developer self-service (Port) -> PR review (CodeRabbit) -> K8s deployment (Dash0) -> Incident triage (ResolveAI / incident.io).
- Standardized benchmarks, telemetry analysis, and security compliance verification.

- **ChatOps & Co-Pilot Coordination:** Integrates seamlessly into Slack / Microsoft Teams with real-time status updates and remediation runbooks.
